purpose: Validate real-data loaders, CafeBERT mean pooling, Unicode lexical tokenizer, BERTopic UMAP+KMeans, topic extraction, and author-aligned metrics before the main benchmark.

bertopic_vectorizer.name: sklearn_unicode_word_hyphen_bertopic_representation
bertopic_vectorizer.rationale: BERTopic c-TF-IDF needs a non-degenerate representation vocabulary on the 858-document corpus; this setting affects only BERTopic topic-word extraction, not S3/LDA/NMF fitting or the shared metric tokenizer.
